description: Recorded structured VLM verdicts per (sku_id, candidate_id), in the D6 schema: what the model read on the pack (brand_text, variant_text, size_text, pack_count, view) and its yes/no/unsure match calls. Code, not the model, turns these into MATCH/MISMATCH/UNSURE. Some entries carry realistic model errors on purpose (see the candidate notes in golden_skus.json). Scenario "gemini_down" forces UNKNOWN for every image.
